name: sahaj-mobile
//overrides: react-native-screens and react-dom are pinned so the tree holds ONE copy of each. Left alone, @react-navigation/* pulls 4.11.1, which has no featureFlags export; expo-router reads featureFlags.experiment at import and crashes on undefined before the app renders — a blank screen that no typecheck or bundle step catches, because neither runs the code. 4.28.0 is the version expo-router ships internally and the one confirmed to render in a real browser. react-dom is pinned to match react exactly: they are one library in two packages, and react-dom is what the web preview renders through, so a skew surfaces there first.
